content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away territory) on the LD rule, targeted at the preferred position.

**What I found:**
- No liquidated-damages, penalty or early-termination-fee clause exists anywhere in the Agreement in the conventional form, and no service credits run to us.
- The live exposure is Subparagraph 23.2 (p0256), read with 23.1 (p0255): a payment default continuing roughly three months lets the Management Committee reclaim our entire allocated APCN 2 capacity, with (i) no payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity, (ii) forfeiture of every amount we had already paid, (iii) loss of Party status, and (iv) continuing liability for accrued unpaid accounts. That is a breach-triggered penalty payable/borne by Customer, unrelated to actual loss and capable of exceeding remaining contract value.

**What I excluded (to avoid double-flagging or over-reach):**
- Subparagraph 18.1 exit timing and the "No credit for capital costs" rule on voluntary withdrawal (p0233) are exit economics under the termination rules, not breach-triggered penalties.
- Paragraph 7.8 financial charges are a prime-rate financing charge, not a penalty.
- 23.3 (Terminal Station continuity) is untouched.

**The redline (validated, ok:true, minimality passed):** two surgical replacements inside 23.2 — the no-credit denial becomes an express statement that no liquidated damages or penalty is payable in respect of the reclaimed capacity, and the forfeiture sentence becomes a non-forfeiture of amounts already paid. Reclamation itself, the Management Committee's discretion, disposition arrangements, and our liability for accrued unpaid accounts all remain verbatim.
